title: Blockwise Stabilized Adaptive Cubic Regularization with Subsolvers via Recurrence
abstract: arXiv:2608.22129v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Cubic regularized Newton methods have the optimal $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-3/2})$ global rate, but a dense subproblem solve limits the feasible block size. Scalable Cubic Newton variants replace the true block curvature with a diagonal, low-rank, Kronecker-factored, or sketched surrogate and, most often, give up the exact cubic step. We introduce a blockwise optimizer that minimizes an independent cubic model per parameter tensor over the true block Hessian, under a per-block adaptive cubic constant and a monotone guard on the full loss. Arbitrarily large tensors are handled matrix-free in a Lanczos-built Krylov subspace, where we prove that the step minimizes the cubic model. The theory also supplies the $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-3/2})$ iteration complexity bound, a second-order guarantee, and monotone per-block descent. translated_title: 基于递归的分块稳定自适应三次正则化与子求解器
translated_abstract: 三次正则化牛顿方法具有最优的$\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-3/2})$全局收敛速率，但稠密子问题的求解限制了可行的块大小。可扩展的三次牛顿变体将真实块曲率替换为对角、低秩、Kronecker因子化或草图化的替代，并且通常放弃精确的三次步。我们引入了一种分块优化器，它对每个参数张量独立最小化一个三次模型，使用真实块Hessian，在每块自适应三次常数和全损失单调保护下。任意大的张量通过无矩阵的Lanczos构建Krylov子空间处理，我们证明该步骤最小化了三次模型。理论还提供了$\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-3/2})$迭代复杂度界、二阶保证和单调每块下降。该外方案的四种变体与原始自适应三次正则化（ARC）优化器进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一种分块稳定的自适应三次正则化方法，通过Krylov子空间无矩阵求解精确三次步，在保持最优收敛速率的同时支持任意大规模张量，并提供了完整的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a blockwise stabilized adaptive cubic regularization method that solves exact cubic steps in Krylov subspaces matrix-free, maintaining optimal convergence rate while supporting arbitrarily large tensors, with complete theoretical guarantees.
